data.text:
No hazard developing.

- All 5 sensors live, none flat/stuck. Room temps flat (S1 27.4C, S2 26.8C, S3 24.7C).
- M1 jumped 4.5 -> 6.56 kW and M2 80 -> 179 mV at t=60.5m, matching Rack B load increase to ~1.24x about 5 min ago. Physics diagnosis posterior 1.0 for load_rackB, 0 for other faults.
- Regression estimated rackB 34.2C (limit 35, margin 0.8C, sigma 2C) triggered ridge_high, but physics forward run shows no breach: p_breach 0, peak margin about -4.6C over 90 min if nothing done.
- Tested power_cap_rackB 0.8 and shed_noncritical_load: both only improve an already-safe margin (-4.7 to -5.7C). No action gate benefit needed since no limit breach plausible.

Trigger is benign load step with no thermal risk. No action requested, no alert sent. Continue routine monitoring.

data.text:
Rack B had a large load surge (~2.6x normal) starting ~15 min ago. UPS power is up 3kW and Rack B voltage drop is high. Hidden Rack B temperature is estimated already over its simulated limit and will worsen without action.

I sent a critical alert and applied a 60% power cap to Rack B (approved, takes effect in ~3 min). This was the best tested option to reduce breach risk.
